IBIT pulled in $665.2 million, its biggest daily inflow since Oct. 7 last year, according to SoSoValue data. Combined, the bitcoin funds last drew more on Sept. Fidelity’s FBTC lost $83.6 million, while Grayscale’s GBTC shed $54.9 million in Monday’s trading session, while the remaining funds recorded no net flows, underscoring how concentrated buying was. The inflow more than erased last week’s $228.5 million of withdrawals, though the funds remain about $90.5 million in the red for October, according to CoinDesk calculations using SoSoValue’s figures. Ether funds moved in the opposite direction, losing $103.3 million in their fourth consecutive session of outflows. items.article_summary: Alt komitenin en üst düzey Demokratı Senatör Richard Blumenthal bu çabaya öncülük etti ve bu da Demokrat milletvekillerinin kripto paranın yasa dışı finansmanı desteklemek için kullanıldığı yönündeki endişelerini daha da vurguladı. Ardoino, X sosyal medya sitesindeki bir gönderide şöyle yazdı: "Senatör Blumenthal'in Tether'in yaptırım raporuna ilişkin 'analizi', Tether'in 2023'ten bu yana OFAC ve NBCTF'nin resmi yaptırım belirlemesinden ortalama 4 hafta önce donduğunu ve Tether'in Chainaliz onları etiketlemeden önce rapor edilen adresleri %99 oranında dondurduğunu gözden kaçırıyor." Ardoino, şirketin eylemlerinin "İran bağlantılı stablecoin hacimlerine yol açtığını" savundu. %94 oranında düşüş gösterdi." Tether'in CEO'su ayrıca geçen Salı günü Washington'daki DC Fintech Week etkinliğinde uzaktan konuştu ve senatörün raporuna da orada değindi. Çeşitlendirilmiş RWA stablecoin'leri, kripto finansmanı ~%4'e sıkışırken gerçek krediden %5-7 getiri sağlıyor.
items.article_context: Stablecoin ihraççısının CEO'su Paolo Ardoino, firmanın stablecoin'lerinin İran'daki finansal aktiviteyi körüklediği yönündeki suçlamalara karşı savunma yapıyor. Tether, geçen ay Senato Daimi Soruşturma Alt Komitesi Demokratları tarafından yayınlanan ve stabilcoin firmasını "İran'ın gölge bankacılık ağı içinde önemli bir finansal cankurtaran halatı" sağlamakla suçlayan bir rapora yanıt veriyor ve Tether CEO'su Paulo Ardoino Pazartesi günü soruşturmanın yaptırımları gözlemlemek için yaptığı olumlu çalışmayı kaçırdığını söyledi. Alt komitenin en üst düzey Demokratı Senatör Richard Blumenthal bu çabaya öncülük etti ve bu da Demokrat milletvekillerinin kripto paranın yasa dışı finansmanı desteklemek için kullanıldığı yönündeki endişelerini daha da vurguladı. Ancak Ardoino, Tether'in şüpheli işlemleri, ABD Hazine Bakanlığı Yabancı Varlıklar Kontrol Ofisi ve İsrail Ulusal Terörle Mücadele Finansmanı Bürosu gibi kuruluşlar tarafından resmi olarak işaretlenmeden çok önce dondurduğunu iddia ediyor. Ardoino, X sosyal medya sitesindeki bir gönderide şöyle yazdı: "Senatör Blumenthal'in Tether'in yaptırım raporuna ilişkin 'analizi', Tether'in 2023'ten bu yana OFAC ve NBCTF'nin resmi yaptırım belirlemesinden ortalama 4 hafta önce donduğunu ve Tether'in Chainaliz onları etiketlemeden önce rapor edilen adresleri %99 oranında dondurduğunu gözden kaçırıyor." Ardoino, şirketin eylemlerinin "İran bağlantılı stablecoin hacimlerine yol açtığını" savundu. %94 oranında düşüş gösterdi." Tether'in CEO'su ayrıca geçen Salı günü Washington'daki DC Fintech Week etkinliğinde uzaktan konuştu ve senatörün raporuna da orada değindi. Şirketi inceleyemeden bunun medyaya yayınlanmasını eleştirdi. "Halkın da hikayeyi bizim tarafımızdan duymasının önemli olduğuna inanıyorum" dedi. Ardoino, "Amacımız kötü aktörleri USDT'den uzaklaştırmak" dedi. "Bu kötü aktörler, ABD'nin kontrolü dışında olan ve şimdi de bizim kontrolümüz dışında olan başka yollara yöneliyorlar." İşin "bitmediğini" ekledi ancak Tether'in rolünden memnun olduğunu söyledi. "Sabah uyandığımda aynada kendime bakıyorum ve doğru şeyi yaptığımızı biliyorum" dedi. Senato raporu birkaç yıl geriye giderek Tether'in işaretli cüzdanları kapsamlı bir şekilde dondurmadığının belirtildiği 2024 öncesi döneme odaklandı. "Bu caydırıcılığın yokluğu suiistimali davet etti: Hamas gibi terör örgütleri Bitcoin ve kripto para birimleri karışımıyla işlem yapmaktan USDT'yi desteklemeye geçti" dedi.

items.article_context_en: The stablecoin issuer's CEO, Paolo Ardoino, has been defending against accusations that the firm's stablecoins have fueled financial activity in Iran. Tether is answering back against a report issued last month by Democrats on the Senate Permanent Subcommittee on Investigations that had accused the stablecoin firm of providing "a significant financial lifeline within Iran's shadow banking network," with Tether CEO Paulo Ardoino saying Monday that the probe missed the positive work it's doing to observe sanctions. Senator Richard Blumenthal, the subcommittee's top Democrat, led the effort, which further highlighted Democratic lawmakers' concerns that crypto is used to support illicit finance. But Ardoino contends that Tether freezes suspicious transactions well before entities such as the U.S. Treasury Department's Office of Foreign Assets Control and Israel's National Bureau for Counter Terror Financing formally flag them. "Senator Blumenthal's 'analysis' of Tether's sanctions report misses that, since 2023, Tether froze on average 4 weeks prior to OFAC & NBCTF official sanction designation and for 99% of the times Tether froze the reported addresses before Chainalysis labelled them," Ardoino wrote in a post on social media site X. Ardoino went on to argue that the company's actions "led to Iran-linked stablecoin volumes declining by 94%." Tether's CEO also spoke remotely at a Washington event, DC Fintech Week, and addressed the senator's report there, as well, last Tuesday. He criticized how it was released to the media before his company could review it. "I believe it's important for the public also to hear our side of the story," he said. "Our aim is to push out the bad actors from USDT," Ardoino said. "Those bad actors are moving to other means that are outside of the control of the United States, and now outside of our control." He added that the work "is not finished," but he said he's happy with Tether's role. "I wake up in the morning and I look at myself in the mirror, and I know that we're doing the right thing," he said. The Senate report went back a number of years, focusing in part on the period before 2024 in which it said Tether didn't comprehensively freeze flagged wallets. "This absence of deterrence invited abuse: Terrorist organizations such as Hamas shifted from transacting in bitcoin and a mix of cryptocurrencies to promoting USDT," it said.

items.article_context_en: may be at stake as the CFTC argues that CME hasn't shown the new policy is hurting it after the agency OK'd its first bitcoin perp. Commodity Futures Trading Commission threw open the doors for perpetual futures in the U.S. in May, approving the first bitcoin perp from Kalshi and suggesting that it was open for business on ensuring a domestic surge in such contracts. But the CME Group objected in court, and the CFTC has responded in court that the derivatives giant has no right to get in the way. "Allegations of increased competition, without any plausible inference of an imminent financial injury," don't give CME the legal standing to challenge the CFTC's actions, the agency said in a brief filed on Friday, noting that volume in crypto futures at the CME has actually risen since its policy shift. Perp contracts had soared overseas, becoming a major form of transaction in crypto derivatives, and the CFTC's move sought to clarify how the market could get rolling in the U.S. The agency — in response to President Donald Trump's aggressive crypto agenda that included bringing perps into domestic trading — said it'll regulate the products on a case-by-case basis as futures. Perps allow traders to speculate on the future price of an asset with a typically leveraged position, and the contracts don't come with a built-in expiration. But CME, which operates the leading global venues for derivatives trading, has insisted the contracts are not futures, because they have no end date. They're really swaps, the company's argument would have it, which would come with an entirely different regulatory approach. Spokespeople for CME didn't immediately respond to a request for comment on the CFTC's latest filing. The CFTC first asked a federal judge to dismiss CME's case last month, and this latest filing details its argument against the company's legal standing. "CME must plausibly allege an actual or imminent increase in competition," the CFTC argued. "CME has not even done that." The agency argued that CME has been telling investors that it hasn't heard of a demand for perps and that they aren't substitutes for the futures it's offering.

Zerohash, kullanıcıların cüzdan adreslerini kopyalamadan veya bir blockchain ağı seçmeden bağlantılı hesaplar arasında kripto taşımasına olanak tanıyan ve dijital varlık işlemlerini basitleştiren bir hizmet olan AUTH'yi başlattı. Kripto hizmetleri firması, Las Vegas'taki Money20/20 konferansında kullanıcıların takas hesaplarını veya kendi saklama cüzdanlarını birbirine bağlamasına olanak tanıyan aracı duyurdu. AUTH genel müdürü Ryan Beaudry, "Kullanıcılar temel teknoloji hakkında düşünmeyi bıraktığında zincir üstü raylar ölçeklenir. Kullanılabilirlik, güven ve kontrol, kitlesel benimsemenin dönüm noktasıdır" dedi. Yapılan açıklamaya göre, daha önce Mastercard'da küresel ürün ve açık finans operasyonlarından sorumlu başkan yardımcısı olan Beaudry, AUTH'un genel müdürü olacak. AUTH, kripto paraları, stablecoin'leri ve hisse senedi tokenleri gibi blockchain tabanlı menkul kıymetleri destekler. Zerohash, hizmetin Coinbase, Robinhood, Gemini, MetaMask ve Phantom dahil 600'den fazla bağlantıyı desteklediğini söyledi. Zerohash'ın geliştirici belgelerinde 639 cüzdan ve dört takas veya aracılık hesabı için destek listeleniyor. Coinbase, Robinhood ve Gemini yayındayken Kraken beta aşamasındadır. Lansman, Zerohash'ın düzenleyici konumunu genişletmeye çalıştığı bir dönemde gerçekleşti. Temmuz ayında, Döviz Denetleme Ofisi, firmanın ulusal tröst bankası sözleşmesine yönelik başvurusunu iade etti; bu, kurumun bir başvurunun maddi açıdan yetersiz olduğunu düşündüğünde attığı bir adımdır. Firma, geri dönüşü idari bir süreç olarak nitelendirdi ve Ağustos'ta daha dar kapsamlı bir başvuruda bulundu. Firma, bu yeni ürünün amacının, fonları taşımak için gereken adımları azaltmak olduğunu söyledi.

items.article_context_en: The launch comes as Zerohash’s bid for a federal trust charter is still pending after its first application was returned. Zerohash launched AUTH, a service that lets users move crypto between linked accounts without copying wallet addresses or choosing a blockchain network, simplifying digital asset transactions. The crypto services firm announced the tool, which lets users link exchange accounts or self-custody wallets at the Money20/20 conference in Las Vegas. “Onchain rails scale when users stop thinking about the underlying technology. Usability, trust and control is the inflection point for mass adoption,” said Ryan Beaudry, general manager of AUTH. Beaudry, who was previously executive vice president of global product and operations for open finance at Mastercard, will be the general manager of AUTH, according to a statement. AUTH supports crypto, stablecoins and blockchain-based securities like stock tokens. Zerohash said the service supports more than 600 connections, including Coinbase, Robinhood, Gemini, MetaMask and Phantom. Zerohash’s developer documentation listed support for 639 wallets and four exchange or brokerage accounts. Coinbase, Robinhood and Gemini are live, while Kraken is in beta. The launch comes as Zerohash seeks to expand its regulatory standing. In July, the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency returned the firm’s application for a national trust bank charter, a step the agency takes when it considers a filing materially deficient. The firm called the return an administrative process and refiled a narrower application on Aug. The goal of this new product is to reduce the steps required to move funds, the firm said.

Ağları bu kadar büyük olduğunda bu çoğu kurucunun yapacağı bir şey değildir. Hoskinson, mühendislerle dolu bir şirketi yönetiyor ve hala gelecekteki Cardano uygulamalarının kendi üzerine inşa edilebileceği aracı yazmayı seçiyor. Başka bir uygulama, arkasındaki her hesaplamayı yeniden yapmadan bu kanıtı kontrol edebilir. Groth16, bilgisayarların hızlı bir şekilde kontrol edebileceği küçük provalar üreten, yaygın olarak kullanılan bir prova sistemidir. items.article_context_en: Hoskinson said on X the language will bundle transaction requests with cryptographic proofs. He hasn’t shared a name, specs or a release date. He says it will be the first to combine what a user wants a transaction to do with cryptographic proof that the rules were followed. “I’m actually personally developing a programming language for Cardano,” Hoskinson wrote on X on Sunday, adding that he’s working on it with Lucas Rosa, a software engineer at Input Output Global who co-created Aiken, one of Cardano’s main smart contract languages. That’s not something most founders do once their network is this big. Hoskinson runs a company full of engineers and is still choosing to write the tool future Cardano apps could be built on himself. The language would support three tools: transaction intents, proof-carrying data and Groth16 proofs. An intent lets a user say what they want done and leave the steps to the app. A trader could ask to swap one token for another only if the final price meets set conditions, without spelling out how to get there. Proof-carrying data attaches cryptographic evidence to a piece of information, showing it follows certain rules. Another app can check that evidence without redoing every calculation behind it. Groth16 is a widely used proof system that produces tiny proofs computers can check quickly. Those proofs can show a condition was met without revealing the private data used to meet it. Together, they could let developers build apps that coordinate trades, check complicated conditions, and pass verified information between services, with Cardano checking a small proof at the end.

items.article_context_en: Bitcoin treasury company Strive continued to add large numbers of BTC to its balance sheet, while far larger peer Strategy acquired only a small amount. Strategy Executive Chairman Michael Saylor is coming under some social media heat for the company’s continued buybacks of its high-yielding preferred stock STRC at just modest discounts to $100 par value. The company this morning announced the repurchase of $193 million of STRC, bringing total buybacks to nearly $2 billion. Strategy also announced an increase in the authorized buyback amount to $3 billion from $2 billion. Recall that the buyback program started this past summer following STRC plunging nearly all the way to $70, putting in question the future of the security. In recent weeks, though, STRC has traded mostly above $98, prompting some to wonder if Strategy’s money might not be better spent on buying more bitcoin at what may (or may not) be close to bear market lows, rather than repurchasing preferred stock trading at only a very minor discount. And others are curious that the fast pace of buybacks (Strategy has less than $9 billion of STRC issued), combined with a 12% dividend yield, hasn’t been enough to fully return STRC to $100. “You don’t build a market worth trillions without investing billions,” said Saylor on Monday, in response to some of that criticism. midterm elections may have less impact on crypto prices than investors expect, according to Jim Ferraioli, head of crypto research at the Schwab Center for Financial Research. Schwab found little evidence that rising odds of Democrats taking control of Congress have consistently weighed on crypto returns, even when prediction market trading volumes were high. While election headlines could trigger short-term volatility, Ferraioli said congressional control has explained little of crypto's recent price movements. Bipartisan support for crypto legislation and the possibility of continued regulatory progress also suggest that a divided Congress would not necessarily hurt the market. Troubled neocloud CoreWeave (CRWV) — despite a general risk-on attitude on Monday and an upgrade to buy at Goldman Sachs — has been unable to hold onto early gains. The stock minutes ago sank below $60 to a new 52-week low after earlier rising to $66.

Bankacılık devi, tokenı Canton Ağına götürmeyi planladığını söyleyerek Ocak ayında Base dışına bir hamle yaptığını belirtmişti. Landriault, kullanılabilirliğinin genişletilmesinin, blockchain ödemeleri yapmak isteyen kripto firmalarına ve işlemleri gerçekleştirmek veya tokenize edilmiş varlıkları geri almak için dijital tokene ihtiyaç duyan finansal firmalara hizmet etmeyi amaçladığını söyledi. Tokenizasyon, gerçek dünyadaki varlıkları ve finansal varlıkları, merkezi olmayan bir defterde kaydedilen ve işlem gören dijital bir forma dönüştürme sürecidir. ABD'de JPMorgan, Citi (C), Bank of America (BAC) ve Wells Fargo (WFC) ile bir düzineden fazla bankanın tokenize mevduatlar için ortak bir ağ başlatma planları var. DeFiLlama'ya göre neredeyse 50 milyar dolar değerinde kripto varlığı Ethereum tabanlı uygulamalarda kilitleniyor. Yurt dışında JPMorgan, bankalar arası mesajlaşma hizmeti Swift'in blockchain tabanlı defterinin özelliklerini ve yönetimini tanımlamasına yardımcı olan 30'dan fazla banka arasında yer alıyor.

items.article_context_en: JPMorgan's dollar deposit token heads to Ethereum in a sign of the lender getting more comfortable with public blockchains. bank, brought its almost year-old crypto token, JPM Coin, to Ethereum as part of a plan to expand beyond Base, the layer-2 blockchain built by Coinbase Global COIN. JPM Coin, which represents dollar deposits at the bank, was technically deployed on the Ethereum mainnet on Monday and is available for institutional clients’ use, the bank said in an emailed statement. The bank chose Ethereum because the blockchain offers more liquidity than rival networks and is already used by institutional clients, Emma Landriault, the head of Kinexys Labs at JPMorgan’s blockchain division Kinexys, said in an interview with Bloomberg, which reported the news earlier. “Issuing JPM Coin first on Base and now on Ethereum is a meaningful step towards providing our institutional clients with multi-chain optionality for moving wholesale money across both the web3 and traditional finance ecosystems,” she said in the emailed statement. The banking giant flagged a move outside Base back in January, saying it was planning to take the token to the Canton Network. Broadening its availability aims to serve crypto firms that want to make blockchain payments and financial firms that need a digital token to settle trades or back tokenized assets, Landriault said. Tokenization is the process of converting real-world assets and financial assets into a digital form that’s recorded and traded on a decentralized ledger. The advantage is speed, including faster settlement of trades, quick movement of money while bypassing delays and frictions involved in traditional rails. Banks have embraced tokenization, but mostly away from public networks. In the U.S., JPMorgan, Citi (C), Bank of America (BAC) and Wells Fargo (WFC), along with more than a dozen other banks, have plans to start a shared network for tokenized deposits. JPMorgan’s private blockchain network, Kinexys, already handles more than $7 billion a day, a small piece in the bank’s $12 trillion a day payments business. Almost $50 billion worth of crypto assets are locked in Ethereum-based applications, according to DeFiLlama. Abroad, JPMorgan is among more than 30 banks that are helping Swift, the interbank messaging service, define the features and governance of its blockchain-based ledger.

items.article_context_en: Curator-managed lending strategies are attracting institutional capital, while exposing depositors to collateral, liquidity and smart-contract risks. Crypto lending vaults have attracted more than $10 billion in deposits, as investors seek returns on their digital assets, according to the Financial Times. Deposits have risen from $4 billion at the start of last year, highlighting growing demand for strategies that put stablecoins and other tokens to work. Vaults operate through smart contracts on decentralized finance platforms. Each has a “curator”, effectively an investment manager, who selects lending strategies, sets risk limits and collects fees. Returns typically range from 3% to 10%, although riskier strategies can generate as much as 20% or more. The appeal comes with considerable risks. Loans can be backed by illiquid tokens, crypto-backed stablecoins or tokenized private credit, leaving depositors exposed if collateral loses value or becomes difficult to sell. Automatic liquidations can intensify market declines, while hacks, coding errors and flawed pricing mechanisms create additional vulnerabilities. Publicly accessible smart contracts offer transparency, but investors may focus on headline yields without understanding the underlying exposure. Fintech companies, digital asset treasury businesses and hedge funds are among the main depositors, according to the article. Bitcoin backed lender Two Prime are among the firms entering the market. In September, it rolled out a bitcoin lending vault on Pareto targeting annual yields of 1.5% to 2% through institutional lending. The vault accepts wrapped bitcoin, requires a minimum deposit of 5 WBTC and has roughly $10 million of Two Prime’s capital committed to absorb initial losses.
